1.chemical: Chlorantraniliprole 18.5% SC 0.3ml/L PHI 21 days (pest) OR Cymoxanil+Mancozeb 2g/L (fungal)

2.label: fresh cotton leaf

2.biological: Preventive NSKE 5% spray as per schedule

3.label: fresh cotton plant
